position_end: Operational and recurrent: the ecological monitoring centre runs a standing vegetation-index bulletin series, the meteorological agency serves European satellite products through a ground receiver and is the regional nowcasting centre for West Africa, and the statistics agency signed a five-year framework agreement in February 2026 to bring Earth observation into agricultural statistics
note: the four sources carrying the subject are all about satellite internet access, not about satellite-derived data feeding an official statistic, cadastre or crop estimate

subject: geopol.usa
name: United States bilateral digital cooperation
milestone: Exploratory meeting with a US Embassy delegation, 2026-08-17
position_end: Under exploration: the ICT minister met a US Embassy delegation on 17 August 2026 to discuss deeper cooperation on cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, connectivity and the digital economy, tied to the New Deal Technologique priorities
note: a meeting rather than an instrument; no memorandum, workstream, funding or timetable is reported

subject: geopol.usa
name: United States development-finance talks
milestone: The digital minister pitched the technology strategy in Washington and held working sessions with the State Department and the development finance corporation
position_end: Discussions scoped to financing mechanisms for digital infrastructure, data centres, connectivity, digital identity and payment systems, plus sovereignty, cybersecurity and AI; no financier, amount, instrument or signing reported
note: the source gives no date for the meetings beyond its publication date

subject: geopol.china
name: Media technology cooperation with China
milestone: Position put at the 7th Sino-African media cooperation forum
position_end: The communications ministry's secretary general, representing the minister, argued at the seventh Sino-African media cooperation forum for African hubs dedicated to artificial intelligence and for deepened technology cooperation with China to accelerate the digital transformation of Senegalese media
note: a stated position; no instrument, funding or work programme is named

subject: geopol.china
name: Sovereign cloud built with Alibaba
milestone: The digital minister states the infrastructure is in testing, equipment installed and verified
position_end: Data-centre infrastructure deployed and tested for redundancy and reliability, to host sensitive national data on Senegalese territory, accelerated ahead of an international sporting event
note: no contract, value, hosting-term, exit or data-access terms are reported

subject: geopol.china
name: Strategic partnership with Huawei
milestone: AI-in-education governance and vendor inputs taken to Beijing, August 2026
position_start: An agreement signed covering data-centre modernisation, an equipment assembly plant on Senegalese territory, and high-level training
position_end: The employment and vocational training minister took AI-in-education governance and the partnership to Beijing on 19 August 2026, setting out four pillars for AI in classrooms - human control, inclusion, responsibility, and sovereignty over strategic data and technology choices - and flagging the vendor's training workshops, teacher upskilling, connectivity, smart classrooms and a shared data centre as inputs to the national digital-education programme, while stating that the Chinese models observed must be adapted rather than transposed wholesale
note: signed a month before the window opened, so it is the baseline rather than news; thirteen months on, the base holds no evidence the assembly plant exists

subject: geopol.eu
name: European Union digital cooperation with Senegal
status: Implemented, no standalone digital instrument on record
milestone: Team Europe package running to 31 July 2027
position_end: Cooperation runs through the union's investment strategy and Team Europe financing rather than a standalone memorandum: a EUR 13m package running August 2024 to July 2027 funded by the union, Germany and France, covering governance, inclusion and innovation with named work on training public actors in artificial intelligence and supporting 20 startups; the delegation states it accompanied Senegal in drawing up its data and artificial-intelligence strategies

subject: geopol.gulf
name: Senegal-Gulf technology investment
status: Implemented, framework instruments with no value or workplan published
milestone: Ten memoranda signed with the United Arab Emirates, 10 December 2025
position_end: A 2023 memorandum with an Abu Dhabi-owned analytics company to deliver big-data and artificial-intelligence solutions for government services, and ten memoranda signed with the United Arab Emirates in December 2025 of which one covers digital infrastructure for the digitalisation of public finances; no value, timetable or counterparty entity is given for the digital item
note: the index returns zero Senegal sources for this relationship

subject: geopol.india
name: Senegal-India technology cooperation
status: Implemented, no digital-specific instrument on record
milestone: Standing bilateral brief current as at April 2026
position_end: Sixteen lines of credit totalling USD 350m across sectors including information-technology training and equipment, and an entrepreneurial training centre at Dakar set up under Indian grant in 2002 that has trained about 6,000 students, upgraded in two phases to December 2023; no instrument dedicated to digital public infrastructure or e-government is named
note: the index returns zero Senegal sources for this relationship
